Medžuslovjansky

Čitajte polny povezany medžuslovjansky PDF-čitateljnik — latinica i kirilica · dostati PDF-fajl.

Glavny cělj tutogo izdanja jest praktično čitanje ljudmi, ktori govoret slovjanskymi jezykami, uključajuči čitateljev bez anglijskogo jezyka. To jest polno medžuslovjansko izdanje korpusa Emmy Noether: statje 1–43, lekcijsko dělo 44, statja 45 i bibliografija. Latinica jest glavno-redakcijny jezyčny tekst; kirilica jest deterministično izvedeny drugy zapis togo samogo teksta, a ne oddělny prěklad ili nezavisny svědok.

Latiničny tekst jest zamrznuty na redakcijnom čelu ISV019-EDIT-0171. Konečny jezyčny scanner imaje 0 blokatorov i 0 nepodprtih projektovateljnyh tokenov. Kirilica jest povtorimo izvedena projektorom v6, ktory ohranjaje pregledane imena, citaty, rimske označenja i TeX-sintaksu. Vse 171 materialne redakcijne rěšenja, iztočniki, odklonjene alternativy i kontrolne sumy sut v javnom paketu.

Sodržanje. Javna versija imaje četiri jasne produkty: polny povezany čitateljnik (1 159 stranic), redagujeme izvorne fajly, arhiv dokazov i pohođenja s publikacijskoju metodologijeju, i spisok SHA-256. The primary purpose of this edition is practical reading by people who speak Slavic languages, including readers without English. This is the complete Interslavic edition of Emmy Noether's corpus: Papers 1–43, lecture work 44, Paper 45, and the bibliography. Latin is the canonical editorial language text; Cyrillic is a deterministically derived representation of the same text, not a separate translation or independent witness.

Version and reproducibility. The exact DOI for NOETHER-ISV-v019 is 10.5281/zenodo.22050935; the stable concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21926382. The Latin text is frozen at editorial head ISV019-EDIT-0171. The final linguistic scanner reports 0 blockers and 0 unsupported projectable tokens. Cyrillic is reproducibly generated by projector v6, which preserves reviewed names, quotations, Roman labels, and TeX syntax. All 171 material editorial decisions, sources, rejected alternatives, and cryptographic identities are included in the public package.

Contents. The public release has four clear products: the 1,159-page complete linked reader, editable sources, an evidence/provenance archive containing the publication-style methods paper, and a top-level SHA-256 manifest. Machine-readable CANON_INDEX.json identifies the Latin text as the language canon and Cyrillic as a derived projection so another session can reproduce or extend the work without inventing a competing canon.
